name: Hevresac
description: Eight rooms in a late-18th-century manor house in central Maó, restored with judgement: original hydraulic-tile floors, vintage furniture, contemporary art and sustainability that isn't posturing (Biosphere certified, natural materials, aerothermal energy). Small, singular and very much of the city.

practicalInfo.acceso: Corner of Anuncivay and San Fernando streets, central Maó; the harbour under 1 km away.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 8 rooms, breakfast of local and organic produce, Biosphere certificate.
